invariants.rationale: After processing, the method always returns a FileHandle instance; it never returns null.
The path parameter must be non-null to be processed with StringTokenizer.
The file parameter must be non-null to call parent() or child() methods on it.
FileHandle child and parent navigation retains the file type (e.g., INTERNAL, EXTERNAL).
The result FileHandle always has a non-negative length in its path.
